APPLE TART WITH PEAR JAM
By: Mitko Dzhordzhev
Published: Friday, September 29, 2017 - 4:38am

Ingredients




1 pre-made whole wheat,unsweetened pastry crust (about 9 inches)
1/2 cup or about 120 grams sugar-free pear jam or jelly (or unsweetened apple sauce)
4 medium size sweet red apples (or any other type of sweet apples)
1 tablespoon ground cinnamon powder (optional)
1 handful of raw unsalted almonds (chopped) (optional)
1-2 tablespoons sugar-free caramel sauce for topping (optional)

Preparation

1 The first step of making this sweet tart is to preheat your oven to 350°F or 170°C degrees. 2 Use a non-stick cooking spray and spray some of it on you cake form or tart pan.If you do not have non-stick cooking spray,brush the pan with some extra virgin olive oil or unsalted grass-fed butter. 3 Take your pastry crust and place it in the pan.Fold the edges to fit not too tight in the pan. 4 With a spoon,spread the pear jam or jelly over the crust. 5 Wash and cut your sweet apples.Cut them into thin slices.Do not peel them. 6 Assemble them on the crust.You can make two layers of apples if you have more. 7 Sprinkle with some ground cinnamon powder over the top. 8 Put the pan in the oven and bake the tart for about 30-35 minutes.Until it is golden brown and fully baked. 9 After baking,remove from the oven and drizzle a little bit of caramel sauce on the top. 10 Cut into portions and serve immediately or enjoy it chilled.

About

Let me show you this yummy,sweet,flavorful and healthier apple tart with pear jam.
